text: Assumption: In case of an error, no instance of OperationOutput is transmitted, but an error status is signaled instead — is this correct?

assumption: In case of an error, no instance of OperationOutput is transmitted, but an error status is signaled instead.
rationale: According to SWS_DM_00796, the structure explicitly contains content only for positive response messages.
